verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API (which includes Issuing endpoints) and search its knowledge base, confirmed by both docs and a probe hit at docs.stripe.com/mcp. However, the evidence doesn't detail Issuing-specific MCP tools or independent hands-on confirmation of agent usage with Issuing specifically. Missing for 10: explicit list of Issuing-specific MCP tool calls, independent/community verification of agent integration.
